pr_title: executor: don't fill generated columns at the non-public state
pr_body:
Signed-off-by: wjhuang2016 <huangwenjun1997@gmail.com>

<!--

Thank you for contributing to TiDB!

PR Title Format:
1. pkg [, pkg2, pkg3]: what's changed
2. *: what's changed

-->

### What problem does this PR solve?
<!--

Please create an issue first to describe the problem.

There MUST be one line starting with "Issue Number:  " and 
linking the relevant issues via the "close" or "ref".

For more info, check https://pingcap.github.io/tidb-dev-guide/contribute-to-tidb/contribute-code.html#referring-to-an-issue.

-->

Issue Number: close #31735

Problem Summary:
In the insert statement, we only fill the public columns. So when calling getOldRow, we should not fill the generated column at the non-public state.

### What is changed and how it works?
Check column state when filling the generated column in getOldRow.

### Release note

Fix a bug that insert statement may panic when adding a virtual generated column
